description: Retrieve detailed insights and enrichments for a list of specific companies. Provide companies by website URL or LinkedIn URL, and optionally specify enrichments like decision makers, technology stack, revenue, funding, employee counts, and department ratios. You can also ask custom natural language queries about each company (e.g. 'What CRM do they use?'). Uses credits (from 1 per company, more per enrichment); precept_check_credits shows the balance. Runs asynchronously and returns an enrichment_id (jobId). Check progress with precept_get_job_status; jobs can take up to about 10 minutes, so checking every ~4 seconds for up to about 150 checks before treating a job as stalled gives the best experience, with a brief progress update to the user every minute or so.

companies.description: List of companies to retrieve insights for (up to 5000). Each company must have at least a companyWebsite or companyLinkedin.

companyWebsite.description: The official website URL or domain (e.g. 'stripe.com' or 'https://stripe.com').

customData.description: Custom key-value metadata to associate with this company for mapping results back to your system. Max 5 properties, values max 100 chars.

enrichments.description: Optional enrichment configuration. See Precept API docs for detailed enrichment types and costs.

country.description: Filter decision makers by country (e.g. ['United States', 'United Kingdom']). Only applicable for decision_makers type.

decisionMakersLimit.description: Max number of decision makers to return per company. Defaults to 5. Only applicable for decision_makers type.

departments.description: Canonical department names to find employees or insights for. Must be chosen from the enum values. CONCEPTUAL MAPPING: Map broad business functions to the closest canonical enum options: - 'Commercial', 'GTM', 'Go-to-market' -> ['Sales', 'Marketing']; - 'Revenue', 'BizDev' -> ['Sales', 'Finance & Accounting']; - 'Tech', 'Software', 'Developers' -> ['Engineering and Technical', 'Information Technology']; - 'AI', 'ML', 'Data Science' -> ['Data & Analytics', 'Engineering and Technical']; - 'People', 'Talent', 'Recruiting' -> ['Human Resources']; - 'Leadership', 'Management' -> ['C-Suite', 'CEO', 'COO']; - 'Cybersecurity', 'InfoSec' -> ['Security', 'Information Technology']; - 'Supply Chain' -> ['Operations', 'Logistics']. For bespoke or custom role titles (e.g. 'RevOps', 'DevRel', 'Full Stack Engineer'), use jobTitles instead. SUBSCRIPTION LIMITS: Max 5 departments and max 10 job titles per subscription.

includeContactDetails.description: Find verified email addresses and phone numbers for decision makers. Only applicable for decision_makers type. Adds contact enrichment cost per person found (1 credit for email per person, 10 for phone per person, or 11 for both per person). Contact details add significant cost, so enable this when the user asks for emails or phone numbers.

jobTitles.description: Job titles to find employees for. Any title works (e.g. 'Software Engineer', 'VP Sales', 'Head of Marketing'). NOTE: The combined sum of departments and jobTitles must not exceed 40.

limitType.description: How the decisionMakersLimit is applied. 'overall' (default): limit is a total maximum across all roles, searched sequentially. 'per_role': limit applies per department/job title.

type.description: The type of structured enrichment to perform. Company-level: 'technology_stack', 'revenue', 'recent_funding'. Department-level (requires departments/jobTitles): 'employee_count', 'employee_count_change', 'department_ratio', 'job_posting_insights'. Lead-level: 'decision_makers' (finds key people by seniority), 'all_employees' (entire directory).

name.description: A readable name for this enrichment job.

queries.description: Custom natural language questions to ask about each company (e.g. ['What CRM do they use?', 'What compliance certifications do they hold?']). Each query costs 0.2 credits per company. Responses returned in query_responses field.

name: precept_get_company_insights

outputSchema.description: Initialization response containing the jobId to poll for results

enrichment_id.description: The unique job ID to poll with precept_get_job_status

finalLimit.description: Adjusted limit based on available credit balance

message.description: Status message describing the initialized job
